name: Botpress
summary: Platform for building and deploying AI agents and chatbots, with a helpdesk and many integrations.
description: Botpress provides a visual studio and a natural-language builder for AI agents, an engine for running them, knowledge bases and tables, and Botpress Desk, a helpdesk for complex support. Agents deploy to webchat, WhatsApp and other channels, and integrate with tools such as Zendesk and HubSpot. The Free plan includes 100 conversations; Plus costs $150 per month billed annually. Seats are counted separately from conversations.

howToUse.title: Open Botpress
howToUse.description: Go to Botpress and choose Try for free to build an AI agent for support.

howToUse.title: Build in the studio
howToUse.description: Use the visual studio or the natural-language builder, add knowledge bases and tables, and run the agent on the engine.

howToUse.title: Deploy and escalate
howToUse.description: Deploy the agent to webchat, WhatsApp or another channel, connect Zendesk or HubSpot, and hand complex support to Botpress Desk, the helpdesk. Free includes 100 conversations. Plus is $150 per month on an annual bill. Seats are tallied on their own and counted separately, not as conversations.
